recommendation.recommendation: Apply organic manure (compost or farmyard manure) to increase soil organic carbon and improve water retention.

actions: Source well‑decomposed compost or farmyard manure (minimum 5 t ha⁻¹, up to 10 t ha⁻¹ depending on availability).
Apply the manure uniformly across the field within the next 7 days.
Incorporate the material into the top 15 cm of soil using a plow or rotavator to ensure good contact.
Schedule a light irrigation after incorporation to help settle the amendment.
Record the amount applied, date, and weather conditions for future reference.
